Messages.Author: Szewski
Messages.Body:
Now it's time to say BIG THANK YOU (the Players) for coming to EC 2018!
It was very beautiful but stressful weekend but in the end the smile on Your faces was precious!
Once more You showed that VtES is more than just a game and for that I want to say THANK YOU!

But this weekend wouldn't be so great without the helping hands of my friends:
Irmina Strzelczyk
Tomasz "Izi" Izydorczyk
Michał "Toy" Kochanowski
Marcin "Dude" Szybkowski
Pascal Bertrand

and last but not least Hugh Angseesing!

But remember! We are for the PLAYERS!
See ya!
Szewski

p.s. give me few days to posting official results, I need to get back on my feet

p.s. VTES.STORE is coming!!!!
